name: My Zypps Cryo Half Ounce - Glitter Bomb
description:
Infused and ready to roll. The My Zypps Glitter Bomb half ounce delivers 14 grams of pre-ground flower, cryo-infused for extra potency and full flavor — no grinder needed, just scoop and go.

Glitter Bomb brings a bright, sweet profile: sugary candy fruit up front with a crisp, sparkling finish.

14G pre-ground cryo-infused flower — half ounce, ready to roll straight from the bag
Cryo-infused — extra potency with a smooth, even burn
Signature Glitter Bomb flavor — sugary candy fruit with a crisp, sparkling finish

My Zypps Glitter Bomb is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
